headline: Gameplay mods gain native plugins, Luau scripts and an MIT-licensed SDK
summary: OpenRAC adds gameplay mods installed from repository links, with ordering, settings, updates and a Purist mode that disables them. SDK 1.1.2 is released under MIT and supports C, C++ and Luau script mods. This is direct development on today's release-only master, with no launcher release recorded today.
highlights: Lock-strafe moves out of the port into a mod. Script mods run across platforms, while Android still lacks native plugins and a Mods tab.
Stable hook identifiers survive renames. Hundreds of object-update hooks are exposed as experimental game internals.
The level editor can change gameplay data and collision. Terrain replacement packs can reshape visuals, but leave collision unchanged.
#22 fixes music-thread crashes at exit and #23 repairs launcher jobs, backups and save handling.
#25 through #28 correct level-copy calls and PS2 integer-width behaviour.
#29 fixes AppImage environment leakage. Other Linux fixes restore confirmation dialogs, menu launching and second-instance handling.
